about: The single source for the ecosystem view: the masters this server reads, the estate's portals and servers, and who uses them. tools/site/ecosystem.mjs renders it into the page (Estate map, Ecosystem tab) and into docs/ecosystem.html. Solid lines exist today; dashed lines are proposed.
title: One read-only finder for agents, reading the masters the estate already has

nodes.name: Government API catalogue
nodes.about: The UK public sector API catalogue, maintained in co-cddo/api-catalogue. This server compiles it at a pinned commit for api_search, without the maintainer contact field.

nodes.name: HMRC Developer Hub
lines: VAT check and UK Trade Info
nodes.about: Two HMRC APIs missing from the catalogue, Check a UK VAT number and the UK Trade Info API, are added by name after checking them at HMRC's own pages.

nodes.name: data.gov.uk
nodes.about: The national catalogue of public sector datasets, searched live by catalogue_search and dataset_describe.

nodes.name: Asset Catalogue
nodes.about: The GitHub Repos Asset Catalogue: UK public sector code on GitHub, explained in plain English, with a view of the API catalogue for people choosing what to reuse.

nodes.name: NDL PubSec MCP
nodes.about: This server. Read-only tools let an AI assistant find data, APIs and MCP servers, check metadata against the model and explain standards. It lists APIs and servers; it never calls them.

nodes.name: DCAT-AP-UK
nodes.about: The proposed UK DCAT profile, set to supersede xGov MEM. It models APIs as data services, and its own MCP server converts OpenAPI descriptions into data service records. Listed by server_search.

nodes.name: DQ Commons
nodes.about: The Public Sector Data Quality Commons: quality rules, frameworks and its own MCP server, listed by domain_list and server_search.

nodes.name: DAM playbooks
nodes.about: Step-by-step guidance for critical data assets, and the DAM Policy Explorer. A link from their checks to this server's metadata checks is proposed.

nodes.name: People
nodes.about: Service teams, publishers, analysts and standards leads, browsing in the portals.

nodes.name: AI assistants
nodes.about: Any MCP-capable assistant, asking this server one question across data, APIs and servers.
